create.name: The Contemplative Society
create.bio:
The Contemplative Society is a Canadian non-profit centred on the Christian Wisdom tradition, while staying open to what other traditions teach. Four members started it on Salt Spring Island, British Columbia, in 1997, and Cynthia Bourgeault, the Episcopal priest and writer, became its resident teacher the following year; it still names her as its founding teacher. Its practice rests on Centering Prayer, the Benedictine balance of prayer and conscious work, attention to the body, and a sense of belonging to the land and the living world.

Run by a volunteer board with a postal base in Victoria, the Society holds in-person retreats on Vancouver Island alongside online retreats and courses, led by guest teachers from North America and regional leaders across Canada. Its website introduces Centering Prayer, the Welcoming Practice, Lectio Divina, Visio Divina and sacred chant, and it now hosts a digital archive of Cynthia Bourgeault's teaching. The YouTube channel offers guided Centering Prayer, Lectio Divina and Visio Divina sessions, nature-based prayer it calls Terra Divina, and talks and interviews with Cynthia Bourgeault.
